Why does my lease keep expiring?

op — 17 Nov 2026

I set the lease to ten seconds and the shard comes back every time a large page is parsed. The parse takes longer than ten seconds but the worker is clearly alive.

Reply · Like

helper — 17 Nov 2026

I set the lease to ten seconds and the shard comes back every time a large page is parsed.

The lease measures time without a renewal, not time without progress. Renew on a timer inside the worker, not after the parse finishes.

renewal:
  every: 3
  grace: 2
Reply

op — 18 Nov 2026

Renewing on a timer fixed it. The queue depth is flat now even on the slow host.
